items.title: Roscoe Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2023
items.q: Niklaus Troxler asked me if I would play the solo in the place of Anthony.

ctx.x: Well you need to get it you know. It’s the “Nonaah” record you know. Niklaus Troxler asked me if I would play the solo in the place of Anthony. And so like I said, I’d already played with the Art Ensemble. So when I went on the stage to take the stage, you had people that didn’t like that you know. And they had decided that they were going to like shout me down you know. So I just picked one of the repetitions. You know you need to get some of my records you know. And then you can understand more clearly like…
When I heard it I imagined it in an etude book and getting to that page and saying oh there’s no way I’m going to be able to play this.
